against.text: Replay: COVID crash would cost -14.3% of the position, about 2,851 USDT at 20,000. what TSLA did on 2020-03-16, the day the market gapped down most.
against.text_zh: 历史危机重演：2020 年新冠暴跌会让仓位亏 -14.3%，按 20,000 的仓位约 2,851 USDT。TSLA 在 2020-03-16 的表现，那一天大盘休市后跳空下跌最多。

against.text: One time in twenty, moments like this lost 4.5% or more over the horizon, about 891 USDT at 20,000. When it did go past that, the average was -7.0%, on 4 episodes.
against.text_zh: 二十次里有一次，与现在相似的时刻在持有期内亏损达到 4.5% 或更多，按 20,000 的仓位约 891 USDT。 一旦跌破这条线，平均亏损为 -7.0%，共 4 次。

against.text: The simulation puts the chance of losing more than 5% at 3%, with an expected shortfall of -5.9% in the worst twentieth.
against.text_zh: 模拟显示亏损超过 5% 的概率为 3%，最差二十分之一情形下的预期亏损为 -5.9%。

against.text: Getting out costs 14 bps on the live book, about 29 USDT at 20,000, before any adverse move.
against.text_zh: 按实时盘口，平仓成本约 14 bps，按 20,000 的仓位约 29 USDT，这还没算不利的价格波动。

against.text: The resemblance may be doing nothing: against random hours of the same kind the difference in mean outcome is +0.17% with p = 0.63.
against.text_zh: “相似”可能没起任何作用：与同类的随机小时相比，平均结果的差异为 +0.17%，p = 0.63。

against.text: 3 of the recalled past calls in conditions like these finished below the level they were sized against.
against.text_zh: 回顾的过去类似条件下的结论中，有 3 个最终跌破了当时定仓位所依据的水平。

against.text: Only 49% of those moments went this position's way, on 80 episodes.
against.text_zh: 这些时刻里只有 49% 朝这个仓位有利的方向走，共 80 次。

supporting.text: Up to 44,913 USDT this is a straight go.
supporting.text_zh: 在 44,913 USDT 以内，这笔交易可以直接做。

supporting.text: A full perp hedge costs 12 bps, which buys out most of the price risk if you want the position anyway.
supporting.text_zh: 用永续合约全额对冲的成本是 12 bps，如果你仍想持有这个仓位，它能抵消大部分价格风险。

assumptions.text: Held for 20 hours, to the next US regular open, then closed.
assumptions.text_zh: 持有 20 小时，到下一个美股常规开盘，之后休市。

assumptions.text: Entered at the token's last price, 371.20, as of 08 Oct 16:00 UTC.
assumptions.text_zh: 按代币最新价 371.20 入场（截至 08 Oct 16:00 UTC）。

assumptions.text: No leverage: a plain token position. Say "5x" to test it on the perpetual.
assumptions.text_zh: 没有杠杆：普通的现货代币仓位。说一声“5 倍”就能在永续合约上测试。

assumptions.text: No stop: the risk is sized on the calibrated 1-in-20 loss instead.
assumptions.text_zh: 没有设止损：改按校准后的二十分之一亏损来定风险。

assumptions.text: Account of 200,000 USDT; the size limits are shares of it.
assumptions.text_zh: 账户 200,000 USDT；各项仓位上限都是它的一定比例。

assumptions.text: The 80 past moments compared against run from Jul 2025 to Oct 2026, across 1 token; the future is assumed to resemble them only as much as the calibration page shows it has.
assumptions.text_zh: 用来比较的 80 个历史时刻，时间跨度从 Jul 2025 到 Oct 2026，涉及 1 只代币；只在校准页面显示过的程度上，才假设未来会与它们相似。

assumptions.text: The crash replays apply TSLA's own stock move from those crises to today's token. The token did not exist then (only the April 2025 shock overlaps its life), so basis, thin night books and listing effects were not part of what was replayed. The five windows were picked after the fact.
assumptions.text_zh: 危机重演是把 TSLA 自己的股价在那些危机中的走势套用到今天的代币上。当时这只代币并不存在（只有 2025 年 4 月的冲击落在它的存续期内），所以价差、夜间薄盘口和上市效应都没有被重演进去。这五个时间窗口是事后挑选的。

assumptions.text: The 2σ and 3σ spike scales volatility by the square root of the hours held over a 24-hour, seven-day year, which counts weekend and overnight hours as if they traded like the day. Over a weekend that is not true; read the sigma label as approximate.
assumptions.text_zh: 2σ 和 3σ 的波动飙升，是按持有小时数的平方根、以一年每天 24 小时每周 7 天来缩放波动率，这会把周末和夜间时段当成和白天一样交易。周末并非如此，请把 σ 标签当作近似值。

assumptions.text: The Monte Carlo band redraws blocks of this token's own past hourly returns and adds up the hours held. It uses only hours the token traded, with no volatility scaling for weekends or news, and it is recorded but not yet scored against outcomes the way the 1-in-20 line is.
assumptions.text_zh: 蒙特卡洛区间从这只代币自己的历史小时收益中抽取成块样本，并累加持有的小时数。它只用代币有成交的小时，没有对周末或消息做波动率缩放；它会被记录，但还没有像二十分之一线那样与实际结果对照评分。

assumptions.text: Fair value is Bitget's index for the stock; the token sits -12 bps from it now.
assumptions.text_zh: 公允价值取 Bitget 对这只股票的指数价；代币现在比它偏离 -12 bps。

assumptions.text: Exit cost is walked on the recorded order book at 17:37 UTC, taker fee on both legs; a thinner book at exit is a separate stress preset.
assumptions.text_zh: 平仓成本按已记录的盘口（17:37 UTC）逐档计算，买卖两端都按吃单手续费；平仓时盘口更薄的情况，由单独的压力情景覆盖。

assumptions.text: No earnings inside the hold (next in 13 days).
assumptions.text_zh: 持有期内没有财报（下一次在 13 天后）。

assumptions.text: No ex-dividend date or split inside the hold in the stored calendar (Nasdaq, Yahoo, Bitget notices).
assumptions.text_zh: 在已存储的日历（纳斯达克、雅虎、Bitget 公告）里，持有期内没有除息日或拆股。

joint_break.plain: If the one-in-twenty bad move for this hold (-4.5%) arrives during US regular hours, when the book is at its thinnest twentieth, the loss is about 891 USDT on the move alone, and leaving costs at least 4 bps more to cross the spread, so -4.5% at the least. In its thinnest twentieth only 487 USDT was sellable inside 25 bps, so about 19,513 of the 20,000 would have to be sold more than 25 bps from the mid. That extra cost is higher than shown and is not measured.
joint_break.plain_zh: 如果这次持有期内一次二十分之一的不利波动（-4.5%）发生在美股常规交易时段、盘口处于最薄的二十分之一时，仅价格波动就亏约 891 USDT，平仓时越过买卖价差至少再多 4 bps，合计至少 -4.5%。在最薄的二十分之一时刻，25 bps 以内只能卖出约 487 USDT，所以 20,000 中约 19,513 要在偏离中间价超过 25 bps 的位置成交。这部分额外成本比这里显示的更高，且没有被测量。
